name: AutoV PM
contribution: Translated your brief into scope: full-market coin scan → per-coin chart analysis → entry/SL/TP plans → $1000 account with 1% daily & monthly loss caps → day-by-day planning → reference research. Prioritised paper-mode safety first.

name: Quant Desk
contribution: Designed the composite scoring engine: EMA 9/21/50/200 trend structure, RSI(14) momentum, MACD histogram, Bollinger position, ADX strength, Stochastic, volume confirmation and candlestick patterns → −100..+100 score with confidence. ATR-based stop-loss and R-multiple TP ladder (TP1/2/3 with partial exits).

name: Risk Guard
contribution: Hard guard rails: max 1% loss per UTC day and per month (auto-halts new entries), 0.5% risk per trade, max 5 concurrent positions, 25% equity cap per coin, remaining-budget checks before every entry. State persists across restarts.

name: API Team
contribution: Binance REST integration (public klines/tickers/exchangeInfo + signed account & order endpoints), automatic live→demo data fallback so the app works even offline, thread-pooled scanner with 60s cache, paper-execution engine, day-by-day planner, event-driven backtester.

name: UI Team
contribution: Dark trading-desk dashboard: regime overview, sortable scanner table, TradingView lightweight-charts with entry/SL/TP price lines, trade-plan card with one-click execution, risk gauges, day planner calendar, portfolio ledger with live uPnL, backtest charts.

name: Reference Desk
contribution: Benchmarked the app against 3Commas, Pionex, Cryptohopper, Bitsgap and open-source Binance bots — adopted their strongest safety patterns (dry-run default, daily-loss kill switch, TP/SL on every order, no-withdrawal API keys) without their monthly fees.

name: QA Team
contribution: Verified all API routes, risk-gate edge cases (daily/monthly halt, budget overrun, position caps), partial-TP ledger math, SL-before-TP conservative backtest fills, demo-data determinism and responsive layout.
